title: Integrative Analysis of Epidermal Barrier Dysfunction Regulators in Psoriasis.
authors: Liu, Yingdi; Wang, Yinglin; Zhu, Haijun; Liu, Yang; Wang, Jinyan; Li, Fangfang; Zhang, Yuxin; Peng, Zhanli; Wang, Wenxin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与机器学习预测银屑病中转录因子ELF3对CLDN1启动子的调控，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测与实验验证，但缺乏三维互作建模或物理模拟，方法深度有限。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Psoriasis is a chronic inflammatory skin disease characterized by keratinocyte hyperproliferation and compromised epidermal barrier function. Although tight junction disruption is a key pathological hallmark, the upstream transcriptional mechanisms driving the downregulation of core barrier proteins such as claudin-1 (CLDN1) remain insufficiently characterized. METHODS: We implemented an integrative multi-omics framework combining weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), and machine-learning algorithms to prioritize core diagnostic features in psoriasis. Upstream transcription factors regulating CLDN1 were computationally predicted using the JASPAR, hTFtarget, and KnockTF databases. The regulatory effect of E74-like ETS transcription factor 3 (ELF3) on the CLDN1 promoter was evaluated using dual-luciferase reporter assays, and the inflammatory response of the axis was examined in TNF-alpha-stimulated HaCaT keratinocytes via quantitative real-time PCR. RESULTS: Machine-learning prioritization identified CLDN1 as a robust diagnostic feature that is significantly downregulated in psoriatic lesions. Multi-database integration converged on ELF3 as a candidate negative regulator of CLDN1. Dual-luciferase reporter assays demonstrated that ELF3 overexpression significantly suppressed wild-type CLDN1 promoter activity, whereas mutation of the predicted binding site abolished this repression. In TNF-alpha-stimulated HaCaT cells, ELF3 was markedly upregulated with a concurrent downregulation of CLDN1. DISCUSSION : These findings suggest that ELF3 functions as a candidate transcriptional repressor of CLDN1 promoter activity and provide preliminary in vitro and computational insights into the transcriptional alterations associated with epidermal barrier disruption in psoriasis, highlighting potential avenues for restoring structural barrier integrity.
abstract_zh: 引言：银屑病是一种慢性炎症性皮肤病，其特征为角质形成细胞过度增殖和表皮屏障功能受损。尽管紧密连接破坏是一个关键的病理标志，但驱动核心屏障蛋白（如claudin-1 (CLDN1)）下调的上游转录机制仍未得到充分表征。方法：我们采用了一种整合性多组学框架，结合加权基因共表达网络分析 (weighted gene co-expression network analysis, WGCNA)、单细胞RNA测序 (single-cell RNA sequencing, scRNA-seq) 和机器学习算法，以优先筛选银屑病中的核心诊断特征。利用JASPAR、hTFtarget和KnockTF数据库对调控CLDN1的上游转录因子进行计算预测。通过双荧光素酶报告基因实验评估E74样ETS转录因子3 (E74-like ETS transcription factor 3, ELF3) 对CLDN1启动子的调控效应，并通过定量实时PCR在TNF-α刺激的HaCaT角质形成细胞中检测该轴的炎症反应。结果：机器学习优先筛选将CLDN1确定为银屑病皮损中显著下调的稳健诊断特征。多数据库整合一致指向ELF3作为CLDN1的候选负调控因子。双荧光素酶报告基因实验表明，ELF3过表达显著抑制野生型CLDN1启动子活性，而预测结合位点的突变则消除了这种抑制作用。在TNF-α刺激的HaCaT细胞中，ELF3显著上调，同时伴随CLDN1下调。讨论：这些发现表明，ELF3作为CLDN1启动子活性的候选转录抑制因子发挥作用，并为银屑病中与表皮屏障破坏相关的转录改变提供了初步的体外和计算见解，突出了恢复结构屏障完整性的潜在途径。
